support_cases_chat_check.name: support_cases_chat_check
support_cases_chat_check.value: "support_cases"."source" <> 'chat' or ("support_cases"."subject_clinic_id" is not null and not "support_cases"."phi_suspected" and "support_cases"."hidden_numbers" + "support_cases"."hidden_emails" + "support_cases"."hidden_treatments" + "support_cases"."clinical_matches" = 0)

support_messages_email_check.name: support_messages_email_check
support_messages_email_check.value: ("support_messages"."kind" = 'email') = ("support_messages"."inbound_mail_id" is not null) and ("support_messages"."kind" = 'email') = ("support_messages"."sender_ref" is not null) and ("support_messages"."kind" <> 'email' or ("support_messages"."direction" = 'in' and "support_messages"."text" is null and "support_messages"."subject_screened" is null and "support_messages"."draft_text" is null and "support_messages"."received_at" is not null and "support_messages"."fields_json" is not null and "support_messages"."inbound_mail_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$' and "support_messages"."sender_ref" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and ("support_messages"."attachments_json" is null or (jsonb_typeof("support_messages"."attachments_json") = 'object' and char_length("support_messages"."attachments_json"::text) <= 300 and "support_messages"."attachments_json"::text ~ '^[a-z0-9_{}":, ]*$'))))

support_messages_email_ids_check.name: support_messages_email_ids_check
support_messages_email_ids_check.value: "support_messages"."kind" <> 'email' or (("support_messages"."message_id" is null or (char_length("support_messages"."message_id") <= 250 and "support_messages"."message_id" ~ '^<[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&*+.=?^_{|}~-]{1,200}@[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,200}>$')) and ("support_messages"."in_reply_to" is null or (char_length("support_messages"."in_reply_to") <= 250 and "support_messages"."in_reply_to" ~ '^<[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&*+.=?^_{|}~-]{1,200}@[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,200}>$')))

support_messages_chat_check.name: support_messages_chat_check
support_messages_chat_check.value: ("support_messages"."kind" = 'chat_escalation') = ("support_messages"."request_id" is not null) and ("support_messages"."kind" <> 'chat_escalation' or ("support_messages"."direction" = 'in' and "support_messages"."text" is null and "support_messages"."subject_screened" is null and "support_messages"."draft_text" is null and "support_messages"."attachments_json" is null and "support_messages"."message_id" is null and "support_messages"."in_reply_to" is null and "support_messages"."fields_json" is not null))

support_messages_fields_check.name: support_messages_fields_check
support_messages_fields_check.value: "support_messages"."fields_json" is null or (jsonb_typeof("support_messages"."fields_json") = 'object' and char_length("support_messages"."fields_json"::text) <= 1000 and position('@' in "support_messages"."fields_json"::text) = 0 and "support_messages"."fields_json"::text !~ '[0-9]{3,}')

support_messages_inbound_check.name: support_messages_inbound_check
support_messages_inbound_check.value: "support_messages"."direction" <> 'in' or ("support_messages"."draft_text" is null and "support_messages"."draft_version" is null and "support_messages"."approved_by_label" is null and "support_messages"."approved_at" is null and "support_messages"."delivery_id" is null and "support_messages"."sent_at" is null)

support_messages_text_check.name: support_messages_text_check
support_messages_text_check.value: ("support_messages"."text" is null or char_length("support_messages"."text") <= 20000) and ("support_messages"."draft_text" is null or char_length("support_messages"."draft_text") <= 20000) and ("support_messages"."subject_screened" is null or char_length("support_messages"."subject_screened") <= 300) and ("support_messages"."message_id" is null or char_length("support_messages"."message_id") <= 998) and ("support_messages"."in_reply_to" is null or char_length("support_messages"."in_reply_to") <= 998)

support_messages_draft_check.name: support_messages_draft_check
support_messages_draft_check.value: ("support_messages"."draft_text" is null) = ("support_messages"."draft_version" is null) and ("support_messages"."draft_version" is null or "support_messages"."draft_version" >= 1)

support_messages_reply_check.name: support_messages_reply_check
support_messages_reply_check.value: "support_messages"."kind" <> 'reply' or ("support_messages"."direction" = 'out' and ("support_messages"."approved_at" is null) = ("support_messages"."approved_hash" is null) and ("support_messages"."approved_at" is null) = ("support_messages"."reply_subject" is null) and ("support_messages"."text" is null or "support_messages"."approved_at" is not null) and ("support_messages"."sent_at" is null or "support_messages"."approved_at" is not null) and ("support_messages"."next_send_at" is null or "support_messages"."approved_at" is not null))

support_messages_send_check.name: support_messages_send_check
support_messages_send_check.value: ("support_messages"."kind" = 'reply' or ("support_messages"."reply_subject" is null and "support_messages"."approved_hash" is null and "support_messages"."send_attempts" = 0 and "support_messages"."next_send_at" is null and "support_messages"."send_stopped_at" is null and "support_messages"."text_delete_after" is null)) and "support_messages"."send_attempts" between 0 and 6 and ("support_messages"."approved_hash" is null or "support_messages"."approved_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and ("support_messages"."reply_subject" is null or char_length("support_messages"."reply_subject") between 1 and 200) and ("support_messages"."send_stopped_at" is null) = ("support_messages"."send_stopped_reason" is null) and ("support_messages"."send_stopped_reason" is null or "support_messages"."send_stopped_reason" in ('dead', 'case_closed', 'clinic_left')) and not ("support_messages"."send_stopped_at" is not null and "support_messages"."sent_at" is not null) and ("support_messages"."text_delete_after" is null or "support_messages"."sent_at" is not null or "support_messages"."send_stopped_at" is not null)

support_messages_approved_check.name: support_messages_approved_check
support_messages_approved_check.value: ("support_messages"."approved_by_label" is null) = ("support_messages"."approved_at" is null) and ("support_messages"."approved_by_label" is null or (char_length("support_messages"."approved_by_label") between 1 and 60 and "support_messages"."approved_by_label" ~ '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .''-]*$'))

support_slack_messages_ids_check.name: support_slack_messages_ids_check
support_slack_messages_ids_check.value: ("support_slack_messages"."channel" is null) = ("support_slack_messages"."ts" is null) and ("support_slack_messages"."channel" is null or "support_slack_messages"."channel" ~ '^[CDG][A-Z0-9]{2,30}$') and ("support_slack_messages"."ts" is null or "support_slack_messages"."ts" ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}[.][0-9]{1,8}$')

support_slack_messages_key_check.name: support_slack_messages_key_check
support_slack_messages_key_check.value: ("support_slack_messages"."shown_key" is null or (char_length("support_slack_messages"."shown_key") <= 300 and "support_slack_messages"."shown_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_:|.-]+$')) and ("support_slack_messages"."draft_version" is null or "support_slack_messages"."draft_version" >= 1) and "support_slack_messages"."attempts" between 0 and 1000

transcript_emails_sent_check.name: transcript_emails_sent_check
transcript_emails_sent_check.value: ("transcript_emails"."status" in ('open', 'pending', 'expired')) or ("transcript_emails"."sent_at" is not null and "transcript_emails"."ses_message_id" is not null)

user_factors_passkey_columns.name: user_factors_passkey_columns
user_factors_passkey_columns.value: "user_factors"."kind" <> 'passkey' or ("user_factors"."credential_id" is not null and "user_factors"."public_key" is not null and "user_factors"."counter" is not null and "user_factors"."device_label" is not null and "user_factors"."backed_up" is not null and "user_factors"."secret_sealed" is null and "user_factors"."last_step" is null)

user_factors_totp_columns.name: user_factors_totp_columns
user_factors_totp_columns.value: "user_factors"."kind" <> 'totp' or ("user_factors"."secret_sealed" is not null and "user_factors"."last_step" is not null and "user_factors"."credential_id" is null and "user_factors"."public_key" is null and "user_factors"."counter" is null and "user_factors"."transports" is null and "user_factors"."backed_up" is null)

user_factors_device_label_check.name: user_factors_device_label_check
user_factors_device_label_check.value: "user_factors"."device_label" is null or (char_length("user_factors"."device_label") between 1 and 60 and "user_factors"."device_label" = btrim("user_factors"."device_label") and "user_factors"."device_label" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

voice_agents_error_check.name: voice_agents_error_check
voice_agents_error_check.value: "voice_agents"."last_error" is null or char_length("voice_agents"."last_error") between 1 and 200

voice_agents_ready_check.name: voice_agents_ready_check
voice_agents_ready_check.value: "voice_agents"."status" <> 'ready' or ("voice_agents"."retell_agent_id" is not null and "voice_agents"."phone_number_e164" is not null and "voice_agents"."config_hash" is not null)

webauthn_challenges_basis_check.name: webauthn_challenges_basis_check
webauthn_challenges_basis_check.value: ("webauthn_challenges"."purpose" = 'register') = ("webauthn_challenges"."enrol_basis" is not null) and ("webauthn_challenges"."enrol_basis" is null or "webauthn_challenges"."enrol_basis" in ('first_passkey', 'step_up', 'code', 'recovery', 'paying_browser'))

website_changes_values_check.name: website_changes_values_check
website_changes_values_check.value: ("website_changes"."kind" = 'added' and "website_changes"."before" is null and "website_changes"."after" is not null) or ("website_changes"."kind" = 'removed' and "website_changes"."before" is not null and "website_changes"."after" is null) or ("website_changes"."kind" = 'changed' and "website_changes"."before" is not null and "website_changes"."after" is not null)

website_changes_decided_check.name: website_changes_decided_check
website_changes_decided_check.value: ("website_changes"."state" in ('confirmed', 'ignored')) = ("website_changes"."decided_at" is not null) and ("website_changes"."decided_at" is null) = ("website_changes"."decided_by_label" is null)
